blocks.title: A reader in another language
blocks.body: A Python reader written from the standard alone passes the same conformance suite as the TypeScript one.

blocks.title: Six sites you can run
blocks.body: A minimal Astro site, Paraline's motion-heavy studio, a ceramics studio, a bakery on Next.js, a journal on SvelteKit and a changelog on Nuxt, all reading the same standard.

blocks.title: The studio, as an editor sees it
blocks.body: Screenshots of the studio editing one of the examples: the form, the visual editor, and the site itself beside them, showing each edit before it is published.

blocks.title: This page
blocks.body: The headline, the claims and the proofs are JSON in this repository, edited in the studio, built by Astro, with no script tag in the output.
